completion_meaning: A completed review means its documented scope has been covered. Open audit findings remain open until their acceptance evidence exists.

items.task: Publish through the repository checks and inspect the deployed site in Chrome.

loops.title: Loop 1: source coverage and local rules
loops.outcome: Reviewed requested sources and resolved identity, typeface, source-rights and home-automation scope conflicts before freezing 101 rules.
checks: 4 brand guides, 33 rules and 12 examples reconciled.
10 writing chapters, 68 rules and 26 examples reconciled.
Official identity and unrelated brand applications excluded; original prose and examples used.

loops.title: Loop 2: independent rule review and complete page reading
loops.outcome: Independent review corrected evidence paths, print-size certainty, chart adapter ownership and automation terminology before applying the guides to the system.
checks: Read all current guides and example records in three bounded review ledgers.
Kept synthetic examples distinct from implemented/live Home Assistant controls.
Recorded 16 confirmed findings separately from 4 migration or completeness recommendations.

loops.title: Loop 3: challenge findings and reconcile coverage
loops.outcome: Challenged findings, separated new-asset rules from older-artwork recommendations, and reconciled the component, page and example registers.
checks: 165 page review records and 301 example ownership records assembled.
68 component URLs assigned to 58 owners; 14 organisation proposals preserve routes.
30 Home Assistant gaps distinguish missing specifications from native functionality; 44 proposals link frozen rules.
Build, automated checks and live publication remain separate verification steps.

loops.title: Loop 4: build, browser checks and correction
loops.outcome: The full run found long evidence links overflowing the new audit page. Visual inspection also found three raw Markdown headings. Fixed the new page, refreshed its review hash, and passed the affected checks plus an added regression.
checks: 466 HTML files pass local link/anchor checks; 101 rule anchors and all coverage records reconcile.
50 Node tests, type checks, supplied-asset/palette parity and HA template compilation pass.
529 browser checks passed initially; the one failing guide and two edited guides pass on rerun. A new keyboard, heading, expanded-table and reflow test also passes.
Existing audit findings remain proposals. No runtime or native Home Assistant change was made.

limitations: Automated accessibility checks are not full WCAG conformance evidence.
Native Home Assistant and third-party behaviour require their own release-specific live checks.
Reference examples use invented household data and do not control devices.
